name: GDP growth (annual %)
description: Annual percentage growth rate of GDP at market prices based on constant local currency.

name: Population, total
description: Total population is based on the de facto definition of population.

name: Political Stability and Absence of Violence/Terrorism (estimate)
description: Measures perceptions of the likelihood of political instability and/or politically-motivated violence.

name: Life expectancy at birth, total (years)
description: Indicates the number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of its birth were to stay the same throughout its life.

name: GDP (current US$)
description: GDP at purchaser's prices is the sum of gross value added by all resident producers in the economy plus any product taxes and minus any subsidies not included in the value of the products.

name: School enrollment, primary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown.

name: Employment to population ratio, 15+, total (%)
description: The proportion of a country's population that is employed.

name: Unemployment, total (% of total labor force)
description: The share of the labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.

name: GDP per capita (current US$)
description: GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population.

name: Arms imports (SIPRI trend indicator values)
description: Arms transfers cover the supply of military weapons through sales, aid, gifts, and licenses and leases.

name: Access to electricity, rural (% of rural population)
description: The percentage of the rural population with access to electricity.

name: Access to electricity, urban (% of urban population)
description: The percentage of the urban population with access to electricity.

name: Individuals using the Internet (% of population)
description: Individuals who have used the Internet (from any location) in the last 3 months.

name: Mortality rate, under-5 (per 1,000 live births)
description: The probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five.

name: Fertility rate, total (births per woman)
description: The number of children that would be born to a woman if she were to live to the end of her childbearing years and bear children in accordance with age-specific fertility rates of the specified year.

name: Mobile cellular subscriptions (per 100 people)
description: Subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service that provide access to the PSTN using cellular technology.

name: Exports of goods and services (current US$)
description: The value of all goods and other market services provided to the rest of the world.

name: Exports of goods and services (% of GDP)
description: The value of all goods and other market services provided to the rest of the world as a percentage of GDP.

name: Imports of goods and services (current US$)
description: The value of all goods and other market services received from the rest of the world.

name: Imports of goods and services (% of GDP)
description: The value of all goods and other market services received from the rest of the world as a percentage of GDP.

name: Voice and Accountability (estimate)
description: Captures perceptions of the extent to which a country's citizens are able to participate in selecting their government.

name: Government Effectiveness (estimate)
description: Captures perceptions of the quality of public services, the quality of the civil service and the degree of its independence from political pressures.

name: Regulatory Quality (estimate)
description: Captures perceptions of the ability of the government to formulate and implement sound policies and regulations that permit and promote private sector development.

name: Rule of Law (estimate)
description: Captures perceptions of the extent to which agents have confidence in and abide by the rules of society, and in particular the quality of contract enforcement.

name: Control of Corruption (estimate)
description: Captures perceptions of the extent to which public power is exercised for private gain, including both petty and grand forms of corruption.

name: Military expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Military expenditures data from SIPRI as a share of GDP.

name: Armed forces personnel (% of total labor force)
description: Armed forces personnel as a percentage of the total labor force.

name: Arms exports (SIPRI trend indicator values)
description: Exports of military weapons through sales, aid, gifts, and licenses.

name: Inflation, GDP deflator (annual %)
description: Inflation as measured by the annual growth rate of the GDP implicit deflator.

name: Inflation, consumer prices (annual %)
description: Inflation as measured by the consumer price index.

name: GNI per capita, Atlas method (current US$)
description: GNI per capita is the gross national income, converted to U.S. dollars using the World Bank Atlas method, divided by the midyear population.

name: GDP (constant 2015 US$)
description: Gross domestic product at purchaser's prices, constant 2015 US$.

name: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added (% of GDP)
description: Value added in agriculture, forestry, and fishing as a percentage of GDP.

name: Industry (including construction), value added (% of GDP)
description: Value added in mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity, water, and gas as a percentage of GDP.

name: Manufacturing, value added (% of GDP)
description: Value added in manufacturing as a percentage of GDP.

name: Services, value added (% of GDP)
description: Value added in services as a percentage of GDP.

name: Gross capital formation (% of GDP)
description: Gross capital formation (formerly gross domestic investment) consists of outlays on additions to the fixed assets of the economy plus net changes in the level of inventories.

name: General government final consumption expenditure (% of GDP)
description: General government final consumption expenditure as a percentage of GDP.

name: Households and NPISHs Final consumption expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Household final consumption expenditure as a percentage of GDP.

name: Foreign direct investment, net inflows (% of GDP)
description: Foreign direct investment, net inflows as a percentage of GDP.

name: Foreign direct investment, net outflows (% of GDP)
description: Foreign direct investment, net outflows as a percentage of GDP.

name: Current account balance (% of GDP)
description: Current account balance as a percentage of GDP.

name: Total reserves (includes gold, current US$)
description: Total reserves comprise holdings of monetary gold, special drawing rights, reserves of IMF members held by the IMF, and holdings of foreign exchange.

name: Total reserves in months of imports
description: Total reserves expressed in terms of the number of months of imports of goods and services they could pay for.

name: External debt stocks (% of GNI)
description: Total external debt stocks as a percentage of gross national income.

name: Total debt service (% of exports of goods, services and primary income)
description: The sum of principal repayments and interest actually paid in currency, goods, or services on long-term debt, interest paid on short-term debt, and repayments to the IMF.

name: Revenue, excluding grants (% of GDP)
description: Revenue is cash receipts from taxes, social contributions, and other revenues such as fines, fees, rent, and income from property or sales.

name: Tax revenue (% of GDP)
description: Tax revenue refers to compulsory transfers to the central government for public purposes.

name: Expense (% of GDP)
description: Expense is cash payments for operating activities of the government in providing goods and services.

name: Broad money (% of GDP)
description: Broad money (IFS line 35L..ZK) is the sum of currency outside banks; demand deposits other than those of the central government.

name: Lending interest rate (%)
description: Lending rate is the bank rate that usually meets the short- and medium-term financing needs of the private sector.

name: High-technology exports (% of manufactured exports)
description: High-technology exports are products with high R&D intensity, such as in aerospace, computers, pharmaceuticals, scientific instruments, and electrical machinery.

name: Fuel exports (% of merchandise exports)
description: Fuel exports as a percentage of total merchandise exports.

name: Fuel imports (% of merchandise imports)
description: Fuel imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.

name: Food exports (% of merchandise exports)
description: Food exports as a percentage of total merchandise exports.

name: Food imports (% of merchandise imports)
description: Food imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.

name: Ores and metals exports (% of merchandise exports)
description: Ores and metals exports as a percentage of total merchandise exports.

name: Ores and metals imports (% of merchandise imports)
description: Ores and metals imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.

name: Trade in services (% of GDP)
description: Trade in services is the sum of service exports and imports divided by the value of GDP.

name: Personal remittances, received (% of GDP)
description: Personal remittances comprise personal transfers and compensation of employees.

name: Population growth (annual %)
description: Annual population growth rate for year t is the exponential rate of growth of midyear population from year t-1 to t.

name: Urban population (% of total population)
description: Urban population refers to people living in urban areas as defined by national statistical offices.

name: Urban population growth (annual %)
description: Annual growth rate of urban population.

name: Rural population (% of total population)
description: Rural population refers to people living in rural areas as defined by national statistical offices.

name: Age dependency ratio (% of working-age population)
description: Age dependency ratio is the ratio of dependents--people younger than 15 or older than 64--to the working-age population.

name: Population, ages 0-14 (% of total population)
description: Population between the ages of 0 and 14 as a percentage of the total population.

name: Population, ages 15-64 (% of total population)
description: Population between the ages of 15 and 64 as a percentage of the total population.

name: Population, ages 65 and above (% of total population)
description: Population ages 65 and above as a percentage of the total population.

name: Net migration
description: Net migration is the net total of migrants during the period, that is, the number of immigrants minus the number of emigrants.

name: Birth rate, crude (per 1,000 people)
description: Crude birth rate indicates the number of live births occurring during the year, per 1,000 population estimated at midyear.

name: Death rate, crude (per 1,000 people)
description: Crude death rate indicates the number of deaths occurring during the year, per 1,000 population estimated at midyear.

name: Current health expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Level of current health expenditure expressed as a percentage of GDP.

name: Out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure)
description: Share of out-of-pocket payments of total current health expenditure.

name: Hospital beds (per 1,000 people)
description: Hospital beds include inpatient beds available in public, private, general, and specialized hospitals and rehabilitation centers.

name: Physicians (per 1,000 people)
description: Physicians include generalist and specialist medical practitioners.

name: Mortality rate, infant (per 1,000 live births)
description: Infant mortality rate is the number of infants dying before reaching one year of age, per 1,000 live births.

name: Maternal mortality ratio (per 100,000 live births)
description: Maternal mortality ratio is the number of women who die from pregnancy-related causes while pregnant or within 42 days of pregnancy termination per 100,000 live births.

name: Government expenditure on education, total (% of GDP)
description: General government expenditure on education (current, capital, and transfers) is expressed as a percentage of GDP.

name: School enrollment, secondary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown.

name: School enrollment, tertiary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown.

name: Literacy rate, adult total (% of people ages 15 and above)
description: Adult literacy rate is the percentage of people ages 15 and above who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement about their everyday life.

name: Literacy rate, youth total (% of people ages 15-24)
description: Youth literacy rate is the percentage of people ages 15-24 who can both read and write with understanding a short simple statement about their everyday life.

name: Labor force participation rate, total (% of total population ages 15-64) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Labor force participation rate is the proportion of the population ages 15-64 that is economically active.

name: Labor force participation rate, female (% of female population ages 15-64) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Labor force participation rate, female is the proportion of the female population ages 15-64 that is economically active.

name: Unemployment, youth total (% of total labor force ages 15-24) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Youth unemployment refers to the share of the labor force ages 15-24 without work but available for and seeking employment.

name: Employment in agriculture (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Employment is defined as persons of working age who were engaged in any activity to produce goods or provide services for pay or profit.

name: Employment in industry (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Employment is defined as persons of working age who were engaged in any activity to produce goods or provide services for pay or profit.

name: Employment in services (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Employment is defined as persons of working age who were engaged in any activity to produce goods or provide services for pay or profit.

name: Gini index
description: Gini index measures the extent to which the distribution of income (or, in some cases, consumption expenditure) among individuals or households within an economy deviates from a perfectly equal distribution.

name: Poverty headcount ratio at $2.15 a day (2017 PPP) (% of population)
description: Population below the international poverty line of $2.15 (2017 PPP) per day.

name: Income share held by highest 10%
description: Percentage of income (or consumption) that accrues to the highest 10th decile of the population.

name: Income share held by lowest 10%
description: Percentage of income (or consumption) that accrues to the lowest 10th decile of the population.

name: Energy use (kg of oil equivalent per capita)
description: Energy use refers to use of primary energy before transformation to other end-use fuels.

name: Fossil fuel energy consumption (% of total)
description: Fossil fuel comprises coal, oil, petroleum, and natural gas products.

name: Renewable energy consumption (% of total final energy consumption)
description: Renewable energy consumption is the share of renewable energy in total final energy consumption.

name: Energy imports, net (% of energy use)
description: Net energy imports are estimated as energy use less production, both measured in oil equivalents.

name: CO2 emissions (metric tons per capita)
description: Carbon dioxide emissions are those stemming from the burning of fossil fuels and the manufacture of cement.

name: Forest area (% of land area)
description: Forest area is land under natural or planted stands of trees of at least 5 meters in situ, whether productive or not.

name: Arable land (% of land area)
description: Arable land includes land defined by the FAO as land under temporary crops.

name: Cereal yield (kg per hectare)
description: Cereal yield, measured as kilograms per hectare of harvested land, includes wheat, rice, maize, barley, oats, rye, millet, sorghum, buckwheat, and mixed grains.

name: Renewable internal freshwater resources per capita (cubic meters)
description: Renewable internal freshwater resources flows refer to internal river flows and groundwater from rainfall in the country.

name: Fixed broadband subscriptions
description: Fixed broadband subscriptions refers to fixed subscriptions to high-speed access to the public Internet.

name: Fixed broadband subscriptions (per 100 people)
description: Fixed broadband subscriptions per 100 people.

name: Container port traffic (TEU: 20 foot equivalent units)
description: Port container traffic measures the flow of containers from land to sea transport modes, and vice versa, in twenty-foot equivalent units (TEUs).

name: Research and development expenditure (% of GDP)
description: Gross domestic expenditures on research and development (R&D), expressed as a percent of GDP.

name: Researchers in R&D (per million people)
description: Researchers in R&D are professionals engaged in the conception or creation of new knowledge, products, processes, methods, or systems.

name: Scientific and technical journal articles
description: The number of scientific and engineering articles published in the following fields: physics, biology, chemistry, mathematics, clinical medicine, biomedical research, engineering and technology, and earth and space sciences.

name: Patent applications, residents
description: Patent applications are worldwide patent applications filed through the Patent Cooperation Treaty procedure or with a national patent office for exclusive rights for an invention.

name: Patent applications, nonresidents
description: Patent applications are worldwide patent applications filed through the Patent Cooperation Treaty procedure or with a national patent office for exclusive rights for an invention.

name: Ease of doing business rank (1=most business-friendly regulations)
description: Ease of doing business indexes the business environment.

name: Time spent dealing with the requirements of government regulations (% of senior management time)
description: Time spent dealing with the requirements of government regulations as a percentage of senior management time.

name: Market capitalization of listed domestic companies (% of GDP)
description: Market capitalization (also known as market value) is the share price times the number of shares outstanding.

name: Stocks traded, total value (% of GDP)
description: Total value of shares traded during the period as a percentage of GDP.

name: Domestic credit to private sector (% of GDP)
description: Domestic credit to private sector refers to financial resources provided to the private sector by financial corporations.

name: Domestic credit to private sector by banks (% of GDP)
description: Domestic credit to private sector by banks refers to financial resources provided to the private sector by other depository corporations.

name: Net ODA received (% of GNI)
description: Net official development assistance and official aid received as a percentage of GNI.

name: External balance on goods and services (% of GDP)
description: External balance on goods and services (formerly resource balance) equals exports of goods and services minus imports of goods and services.

name: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added in agriculture, forestry, and fishing (constant 2015 US$).

name: Industry (including construction), value added (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added in mining, manufacturing, construction, electricity, water, and gas (constant 2015 US$).

name: Manufacturing, value added (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added in manufacturing (constant 2015 US$).

name: Services, value added (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added in services (constant 2015 US$).

name: GDP per capita (constant 2015 US$)
description: GDP per capita is gross domestic product divided by midyear population.

name: GDP per capita, PPP (current international $)
description: GDP per capita based on purchasing power parity (PPP).

name: GDP, PPP (current international $)
description: PPP GDP is gross domestic product converted to international dollars using purchasing power parity rates.

name: Unemployment, female (% of female labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Unemployment, female refers to the share of the female labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.

name: Unemployment, male (% of male labor force) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Unemployment, male refers to the share of the male labor force that is without work but available for and seeking employment.

name: Vulnerable employment, total (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Vulnerable employment is contributing family workers and own-account workers as a percentage of total employment.

name: Labor force, total
description: Total labor force comprises people ages 15 and older who meet the International Labour Organization definition of the economically active population.

name: Population, female (% of total population)
description: Female population is the percentage of the population that is female.

name: Proportion of seats held by women in national parliaments (%)
description: Women in parliaments are the percentage of parliamentary seats in a single or lower chamber held by women.

name: Mortality rate, neonatal (per 1,000 live births)
description: Neonatal mortality rate is the number of neonates dying before reaching 28 days of age, per 1,000 live births.

name: Immunization, measles (% of children ages 12-23 months)
description: Child immunization measures the percentage of children ages 12-23 months who received the measles vaccination.

name: Immunization, DPT (% of children ages 12-23 months)
description: Child immunization measures the percentage of children ages 12-23 months who received DPT vaccinations.

name: People using at least basic drinking water services (% of population)
description: The percentage of people using at least basic water services.

name: People using at least basic sanitation services (% of population)
description: The percentage of people using at least basic sanitation services.

name: People practicing open defecation (% of population)
description: People practicing open defecation refers to the percentage of the population defecating in the open.

name: Prevalence of anemia among children (% of children under 5)
description: Prevalence of anemia, children under age 5, is the percentage of children under age 5 whose hemoglobin level is less than 110 grams per liter.

name: Primary completion rate, total (% of relevant age group)
description: Primary completion rate is the percentage of students completing the last year of primary school.

name: Lower secondary completion rate, total (% of relevant age group)
description: Lower secondary completion rate is the percentage of students completing the last year of lower secondary education.

name: Primary education, teachers (% female)
description: Percentage of teachers in primary education who are female.

name: Secondary education, teachers (% female)
description: Percentage of teachers in secondary education who are female.

name: Population density (people per sq. km of land area)
description: Population density is midyear population divided by land area in square kilometers.

name: Food production index (2014-2016 = 100)
description: Food production index covers food crops that are considered edible and that contain nutrients.

name: Crop production index (2014-2016 = 100)
description: Crop production index shows agricultural production for each year relative to the base period 2014-2016.

name: Livestock production index (2014-2016 = 100)
description: Livestock production index includes meat and milk from all sources, dairy products such as cheese, and eggs, honey, raw silk, wool, and hides and skins.

name: Terrestrial and marine protected areas (% of total territorial area)
description: Terrestrial and marine protected areas are totally or partially protected areas of at least 1,000 hectares.

name: Access to electricity (% of population)
description: Access to electricity is the percentage of population with access to electricity.

name: Renewable electricity output (% of total electricity output)
description: Renewable electricity is the share of electricity generated by renewable power plants in total electricity generated by all types of plants.

name: Electricity production from coal sources (% of total)
description: Sources of electricity production, coal: share of total electricity production.

name: Electricity production from natural gas sources (% of total)
description: Sources of electricity production, natural gas: share of total electricity production.

name: Electricity production from nuclear sources (% of total)
description: Sources of electricity production, nuclear power: share of total electricity production.

name: Electricity production from hydroelectric sources (% of total)
description: Sources of electricity production, hydroelectric: share of total electricity production.

name: Merchandise trade (% of GDP)
description: Merchandise trade as a share of GDP is the sum of merchandise exports and imports divided by the value of GDP.

name: Export volume index (2000 = 100)
description: Export volume indexes are derived from UNCTAD's volume index series.

name: Import volume index (2000 = 100)
description: Import volume indexes are derived from UNCTAD's volume index series.

name: Net barter terms of trade index (2000 = 100)
description: Net barter terms of trade index is calculated as the percentage ratio of the export unit value indexes to the import unit value indexes.

name: Short-term debt (% of total external debt)
description: Short-term debt as a percentage of total external debt.

name: Present value of external debt (% of exports of goods, services and primary income)
description: Present value of debt as a percentage of exports of goods, services and primary income.

name: Present value of external debt (% of GNI)
description: Present value of debt as a percentage of GNI.

name: Adjusted net savings, including particulate emission damage (% of GNI)
description: Adjusted net savings are equal to net national savings plus education expenditure and minus energy depletion, mineral depletion, net forest depletion, and carbon dioxide and particulate emissions damage.

name: Adjusted savings: mineral depletion (% of GNI)
description: Mineral depletion is the ratio of the value of the stock of mineral resources to the remaining reserve lifetime.

name: Adjusted savings: energy depletion (% of GNI)
description: Energy depletion is the ratio of the value of the stock of energy resources to the remaining reserve lifetime.

name: Adjusted savings: carbon dioxide damage (% of GNI)
description: Cost of damage due to carbon dioxide emissions from fossil fuel use and the manufacture of cement.

name: Adjusted savings: education expenditure (% of GNI)
description: Education expenditure refers to the current operating expenditures in education, including wages and salaries and excluding capital investments in buildings and equipment.

name: Adolescent fertility rate (births per 1,000 women ages 15-19)
description: Adolescent fertility rate is the number of births per 1,000 women ages 15-19.

name: Prevalence of HIV, total (% of population ages 15-49)
description: Prevalence of HIV refers to the percentage of people ages 15-49 who are infected with HIV.

name: Incidence of tuberculosis (per 100,000 people)
description: Incidence of tuberculosis is the estimated number of new and relapse tuberculosis cases arising in a given year.

name: Mortality caused by road traffic injury (per 100,000 people)
description: Mortality caused by road traffic injury is number of road traffic fatal injury deaths per 100,000 population.

name: Mortality rate attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene (per 100, 000 population)
description: Mortality rate attributed to unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene is the number of deaths from unsafe water, unsafe sanitation and lack of hygiene per 100,000 population.

name: Mortality rate attributed to household and ambient air pollution (per 100, 000 population)
description: Mortality rate attributed to household and ambient air pollution is the number of deaths from household and ambient air pollution per 100,000 population.

name: Mobile cellular subscriptions
description: Mobile cellular subscriptions are subscriptions to a public mobile telephone service.

name: Fixed telephone subscriptions (per 100 people)
description: Fixed telephone subscriptions refers to the sum of active number of analogue fixed telephone lines.

name: Secure Internet servers (per 1 million people)
description: Secure Internet servers are servers using encryption technology in Internet transactions.

name: Liner shipping connectivity index (maximum value in 2004 = 100)
description: The Liner Shipping Connectivity Index captures how well countries are connected to global shipping networks.

name: Air transport, registered carrier departures worldwide
description: Registered carrier departures worldwide are the number of takeoffs and takeoffs abroad of air carriers registered in the country.

name: Statistical capacity score (Overall average)
description: Statistical capacity score is a composite score assessing the capacity of a country's statistical system.

name: Intentional homicides (per 100,000 people)
description: Intentional homicides are estimates of unlawful homicides purposely inflicted as a result of domestic disputes, interpersonal violence, violent conflicts over land resources, intergang violence over turf or control, and predatory violence and killing by armed groups.

name: Refugee population by country or territory of asylum
description: Refugees are people who are recognized as refugees under the 1951 Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees or its 1967 Protocol.

name: Refugee population by country or territory of origin
description: Refugees are people who are recognized as refugees under the 1951 Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees or its 1967 Protocol.

name: Poverty headcount ratio at national poverty lines (% of population)
description: Poverty headcount ratio at national poverty lines (% of population).

name: Poverty headcount ratio at $6.85 a day (2017 PPP) (% of population)
description: Population below the international poverty line of $6.85 (2017 PPP) per day.

name: Children in employment, total (% of children ages 7-14)
description: Children in employment refer to children involved in economic activity for at least one hour in the reference week.

name: Self-employed, total (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Self-employed workers are those workers who, working on their own account or with one or a few partners or in cooperative, hold the type of jobs defined as a self-employment jobs.

name: Contributing family workers, total (% of total employment) (modeled ILO estimate)
description: Contributing family workers are those workers who hold self-employment jobs as own-account workers in a market-oriented establishment operated by a related person living in the same household.

name: Agriculture, forestry, and fishing, value added per worker (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added per worker is a measure of labor productivity in agriculture.

name: Industry (including construction), value added per worker (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added per worker is a measure of labor productivity in industry.

name: Services, value added per worker (constant 2015 US$)
description: Value added per worker is a measure of labor productivity in services.

name: Gross capital formation (constant 2015 US$)
description: Gross capital formation (constant 2015 US$).

name: General government final consumption expenditure (constant 2015 US$)
description: General government final consumption expenditure (constant 2015 US$).

name: Households and NPISHs Final consumption expenditure (constant 2015 US$)
description: Household final consumption expenditure (constant 2015 US$).

name: GNI (constant 2015 US$)
description: GNI (constant 2015 US$).

name: GNI per capita (constant 2015 US$)
description: GNI per capita (constant 2015 US$).

name: GNI per capita, PPP (current international $)
description: GNI per capita based on purchasing power parity (PPP).

name: GNI, PPP (current international $)
description: GNI based on purchasing power parity (PPP).

name: Net secondary income (BoP, current US$)
description: Net secondary income (formerly current transfers) includes general government and other sectors.

name: Net capital account (BoP, current US$)
description: Net capital account includes gross acquisitions/disposals of nonproduced nonfinancial assets and capital transfers.

name: External debt stocks, total (% of GDP)
description: Total external debt stocks as a percentage of GDP.

name: Total debt service (% of GNI)
description: Total debt service as a percentage of GNI.

name: Interest payments on external debt (% of GNI)
description: Interest payments on external debt as a percentage of GNI.

name: Interest payments on external debt (% of exports of goods, services and primary income)
description: Interest payments on external debt as a percentage of exports of goods, services and primary income.

name: Principal repayments on external debt (% of GNI)
description: Principal repayments on external debt as a percentage of GNI.

name: Principal repayments on external debt (% of exports of goods, services and primary income)
description: Principal repayments on external debt as a percentage of exports of goods, services and primary income.

name: Manufactures imports (% of merchandise imports)
description: Manufactures imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.

name: Manufactures exports (% of merchandise exports)
description: Manufactures exports as a percentage of total merchandise exports.

name: Agricultural raw materials imports (% of merchandise imports)
description: Agricultural raw materials imports as a percentage of total merchandise imports.

name: Agricultural raw materials exports (% of merchandise exports)
description: Agricultural raw materials exports as a percentage of total merchandise exports.

name: ICT goods imports (% total goods imports)
description: ICT goods imports include telecommunications, audio and video, computer and related equipment; electronic components; and other ICT goods.

name: ICT goods exports (% of total goods exports)
description: ICT goods exports include telecommunications, audio and video, computer and related equipment; electronic components; and other ICT goods.

name: Domestic private health expenditure (% of current health expenditure)
description: Share of domestic private health expenditure of total current health expenditure.

name: Domestic general government health expenditure (% of current health expenditure)
description: Share of domestic general government health expenditure of total current health expenditure.

name: External health expenditure (% of current health expenditure)
description: Share of external health expenditure of total current health expenditure.

name: Mortality rate, adult, male (per 1,000 male adults)
description: Adult mortality rate, male, is the probability of dying between the ages of 15 and 60.

name: Mortality rate, adult, female (per 1,000 female adults)
description: Adult mortality rate, female, is the probability of dying between the ages of 15 and 60.

name: Survival to age 65, male (% of cohort)
description: Survival to age 65, male, is the percentage of a cohort of newborn infants that would survive to age 65, if subject to current mortality rates.

name: Survival to age 65, female (% of cohort)
description: Survival to age 65, female, is the percentage of a cohort of newborn infants that would survive to age 65, if subject to current mortality rates.

name: Risk of impoverishing expenditure for surgical care (% of people at risk)
description: The proportion of population at risk of impoverishing expenditure when surgical care is required.

name: Risk of catastrophic expenditure for surgical care (% of people at risk)
description: The proportion of population at risk of catastrophic expenditure when surgical care is required.

name: School enrollment, preprimary (% gross)
description: Gross enrollment ratio is the ratio of total enrollment, regardless of age, to the population of the age group that officially corresponds to the level of education shown.

name: School enrollment, primary (% net)
description: Net enrollment rate is the ratio of children of official school age who are enrolled in school to the population of the corresponding official school age.

name: School enrollment, secondary (% net)
description: Net enrollment rate is the ratio of children of official school age who are enrolled in school to the population of the corresponding official school age.

name: Persistence to last grade of primary, total (% of cohort)
description: Persistence to last grade of primary is the percentage of children enrolled in the first grade of primary school who eventually reach the last grade of primary education.

name: Repeaters, primary (% of total enrollment)
description: Repeaters, primary is the number of students enrolled in the same grade as in the previous year, expressed as a percentage of the total enrollment in primary school.

name: Progression to secondary school (%)
description: Progression to secondary school is the number of new entrants to the first grade of secondary school as a percentage of the number of students who completed the last grade of primary school the previous year.

name: Labor force with advanced education (% of total working-age population with advanced education)
description: The percentage of the working-age population with an advanced education who are in the labor force.

name: Labor force with basic education (% of total working-age population with basic education)
description: The percentage of the working-age population with a basic education who are in the labor force.

name: Labor force with intermediate education (% of total working-age population with intermediate education)
description: The percentage of the working-age population with an intermediate education who are in the labor force.

name: GDP per person employed (constant 2017 PPP $)
description: GDP per person employed is gross domestic product (GDP) divided by total employment in the economy.

name: Share of youth not in education, employment or training, total (% of youth population), process
description: Share of youth not in education, employment or training (NEET) is the proportion of young people who are not in employment, education, or training.

name: CO2 emissions from gaseous fuel consumption (% of total)
description: CO2 emissions from gaseous fuel consumption.

name: CO2 emissions from liquid fuel consumption (% of total)
description: CO2 emissions from liquid fuel consumption.

name: CO2 emissions from solid fuel consumption (% of total)
description: CO2 emissions from solid fuel consumption.

name: Agricultural land (% of land area)
description: Agricultural land refers to the share of land area that is arable or under permanent crops or under permanent pastures.

name: Pump price for diesel fuel (US$ per liter)
description: Fuel prices refer to the pump prices of the most widely sold grade of diesel fuel.

name: Pump price for gasoline (US$ per liter)
description: Fuel prices refer to the pump prices of the most widely sold grade of gasoline.

name: International migrant stock (% of population)
description: International migrant stock is the number of people born in a country other than that in which they live, including refugees.

name: Life expectancy at birth, female (years)
description: Life expectancy at birth indicates the number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of its birth were to stay the same throughout its life.

name: Life expectancy at birth, male (years)
description: Life expectancy at birth indicates the number of years a newborn infant would live if prevailing patterns of mortality at the time of its birth were to stay the same throughout its life.

name: Mortality rate, infant, female (per 1,000 live births)
description: Infant mortality rate is the number of infants dying before reaching one year of age, per 1,000 live births.

name: Mortality rate, infant, male (per 1,000 live births)
description: Infant mortality rate is the number of infants dying before reaching one year of age, per 1,000 live births.

name: Mortality rate, under-5, female (per 1,000 live births)
description: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five.

name: Mortality rate, under-5, male (per 1,000 live births)
description: Under-five mortality rate is the probability per 1,000 that a newborn baby will die before reaching age five.

name: Women Business and the Law Index Score (scale 1-100)
description: Measures the laws and regulations that affect women's economic opportunity.

name: Account ownership at a financial institution or with a mobile-money-service provider (% of population ages 15+)
description: Percentage of the population ages 15 and older who report having an account at a bank or mobile money provider.

name: PM2.5 air pollution mean annual exposure (micrograms per cubic meter)
description: Population-weighted exposure to ambient PM2.5 pollution; a key indicator for environmental health.

name: Prevalence of stunting height for age (% of children under 5)
description: Percentage of children under age 5 whose height for age is more than two standard deviations below the median; a primary measure of chronic malnutrition.

name: Time required to start a business (days)
description: The number of calendar days needed to complete the procedures to legally operate a business.

name: Nurses and midwives (per 1000 people)
description: The number of nurses and midwives per 1,000 people; crucial for measuring healthcare system capacity beyond just physicians.

name: Population living in slums (% of urban population)
description: Proportion of urban population living in slum households; a key metric for urban development and poverty.

name: Total alcohol consumption per capita (liters of pure alcohol projected estimates 15+ years of age)
description: Recorded and unrecorded alcohol consumption per capita; used as a proxy for social health risks.

name: Automated teller machines (ATMs) (per 100000 adults)
description: The number of ATMs per 100,000 adults; a strong indicator of physical financial infrastructure access.

name: School enrollment primary (gross) gender parity index (GPI)
description: Ratio of female to male gross enrollment rates in primary education; measures gender equity in education access.

name: Land area where elevation is below 5 meters (% of total land area)
description: Percentage of land area below 5 meters; indicates vulnerability to sea-level rise and climate change.

name: Suicide mortality rate (per 100000 population)
description: Crude suicide mortality rate per 100,000 population; a critical indicator for mental health and social distress.

name: Internally displaced persons - new displacement associated with conflict and violence (number of cases)
description: The number of individuals who have been forced to leave their homes due to conflict but remain within their country's borders.

name: Roads paved (% of total roads)
description: The percentage of all roads that are paved; a key measure of transport infrastructure quality.

name: Annual freshwater withdrawals total (% of internal resources)
description: The ratio of total freshwater withdrawals to total renewable internal freshwater resources; measures water stress.

name: CPIA transparency_accountability and corruption in the public sector rating (1=low to 6=high)
description: Assesses the extent to which the executive can be held accountable for its use of funds and for the results of its actions.

name: Sex ratio at birth (male births per female births)
description: The number of male births for every female birth; significant deviations indicate gender bias.

name: Droughts floods extreme temperatures (% of population hit by disasters)
description: Percentage of the population affected by droughts, floods, and extreme temperatures; measures climate resilience.
